mapper.sql: w.id workshop_id,w.workshop_code,w.workshop_name, c.id work_center_id,c.center_code work_center_code,c.center_name work_center_name, os.id operation_spec_id,os.operation_code,os.operation_name, o.id order_id,o.order_no,ol.id order_line_id,ol.line_no, i.id item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name, pl.id production_lot_id,pl.lot_no,t.id task_id,t.task_code,t.task_name,t.status task_status, t.uom_code,COALESCE(ol.promised_at,o.promised_at) promised_at

JOIN aps_task t ON t.id=m.task_id JOIN aps_operation_spec os ON os.id=t.operation_spec_id JOIN aps_production_lot pl ON pl.id=t.production_lot_id JOIN aps_order_line ol ON ol.id=pl.order_line_id JOIN aps_order o ON o.id=ol.order_id JOIN aps_item i ON i.id=ol.item_id LEFT JOIN aps_work_center c ON c.id=t.work_center_id LEFT JOIN aps_workshop w ON w.id=c.workshop_id
mapper.select: SELECT id,version_name,published_at,daily_baseline_date FROM aps_plan_version WHERE status='PUBLISHED' AND is_current=1

SELECT r.id resource_id,r.resource_code,r.resource_name,r.team_name, w.id workshop_id,w.workshop_code,w.workshop_name, c.id work_center_id,c.center_code work_center_code,c.center_name work_center_name, rs.skill_code,rs.valid_from skill_valid_from,rs.valid_to skill_valid_to FROM aps_resource r JOIN aps_workshop w ON w.id=r.workshop_id LEFT JOIN aps_work_center c ON c.id=r.work_center_id LEFT JOIN aps_resource_skill rs ON rs.resource_id=r.id AND rs.status='ACTIVE' AND (rs.valid_from IS NULL OR rs.valid_from<#{toAt}) AND (rs.valid_to IS NULL OR rs.valid_to>#{fromAt}) WHERE r.resource_type='PERSON' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND (#{allScope}=TRUE OR w.manager_user_id=#{actorUserId}) AND w.id=#{workshopId} AND c.id=#{workCenterId} ORDER BY w.workshop_code,c.center_code,r.resource_code,rs.skill_code,rs.valid_from

SELECT a.resource_id,a.window_type,a.start_at,a.end_at,a.capacity_ratio FROM aps_resource_availability a JOIN aps_resource r ON r.id=a.resource_id JOIN aps_workshop w ON w.id=r.workshop_id LEFT JOIN aps_work_center c ON c.id=r.work_center_id WHERE r.resource_type='PERSON' AND r.status='ACTIVE' AND a.start_at<#{toAt} AND a.end_at>#{fromAt} AND (#{allScope}=TRUE OR w.manager_user_id=#{actorUserId}) AND w.id=#{workshopId} AND c.id=#{workCenterId} ORDER BY a.resource_id,a.start_at,a.end_at,a.window_type

SELECT s.id segment_id,a.id allocation_id,a.resource_id, COALESCE(rr.required_skill_code,'UNSPECIFIED') skill_code, s.start_at,s.end_at FROM aps_plan_segment s JOIN aps_plan_job j ON j.id=s.plan_job_id JOIN aps_plan_allocation a ON a.plan_segment_id=s.id AND a.allocation_role='PERSON' JOIN aps_resource_requirement rr ON rr.id=a.resource_requirement_id JOIN aps_resource r ON r.id=a.resource_id JOIN aps_workshop w ON w.id=r.workshop_id LEFT JOIN aps_work_center c ON c.id=r.work_center_id WHERE j.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} AND s.start_at<#{toAt} AND s.end_at>#{fromAt} AND (#{allScope}=TRUE OR w.manager_user_id=#{actorUserId}) AND w.id=#{workshopId} AND c.id=#{workCenterId} AND rr.required_skill_code=#{skillCode} ORDER BY s.start_at,s.id,a.seat_no

SELECT t.id task_id,COALESCE(rr.required_skill_code,t.required_skill_code,'UNSPECIFIED') skill_code, 1 required_people, CAST(SUM((ph.fixed_seconds + ph.seconds_per_unit*t.task_qty)*rr.seat_count) AS SIGNED) required_seconds FROM aps_task t LEFT JOIN aps_work_center c ON c.id=t.work_center_id LEFT JOIN aps_workshop w ON w.id=c.workshop_id JOIN aps_operation_phase ph ON ph.operation_spec_id=t.operation_spec_id JOIN aps_resource_requirement rr ON rr.operation_phase_id=ph.id AND rr.resource_type='PERSON' AND rr.optional_flag=0 WHERE t.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') AND (#{planVersionId} IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aps_plan_job_member pm JOIN aps_plan_job pj ON pj.id=pm.plan_job_id WHERE pm.task_id=t.id AND pj.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId})) AND (#{allScope}=TRUE OR w.manager_user_id=#{actorUserId}) AND w.id=#{workshopId} AND c.id=#{workCenterId} AND COALESCE(rr.required_skill_code,t.required_skill_code)=#{skillCode} GROUP BY t.id,COALESCE(rr.required_skill_code,t.required_skill_code,'UNSPECIFIED') ORDER BY skill_code,t.id

SELECT o.id order_id,o.order_no,o.status order_status,o.promised_at order_promised_at, ol.id order_line_id,ol.line_no,ol.status line_status,ol.promised_at line_promised_at, i.id item_id,i.item_code,i.item_name,ol.demand_qty,ol.uom_code, t.id task_id,t.task_code,t.status task_status, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aps_route_edge edge WHERE edge.route_version_id=t.route_version_id AND edge.predecessor_node_id=t.route_node_id) terminal_task, planned.planned_end_at, CASE WHEN terminal_release.task_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE terminal_release.released_qty END terminal_released_qty, terminal_release.released_at terminal_released_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aps_material_demand md WHERE md.target_task_id=t.id AND md.material_status NOT IN ('AVAILABLE','CONSUMED','CANCELLED')) unavailable_material_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aps_output_lot out_lot WHERE out_lot.source_task_id=t.id AND out_lot.quality_status IN ('PENDING','HOLD','REJECTED')) quality_hold_count, (t.work_center_id IS NULL) missing_resource, (t.setup_seconds+t.run_seconds+t.unload_seconds+t.wait_seconds+t.transport_seconds=0) missing_duration, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aps_production_lot hidden_pl JOIN aps_task hidden_t ON hidden_t.production_lot_id=hidden_pl.id AND hidden_t.status<>'CANCELLED' LEFT JOIN aps_work_center hidden_c ON hidden_c.id=hidden_t.work_center_id LEFT JOIN aps_workshop hidden_w ON hidden_w.id=hidden_c.workshop_id WHERE hidden_pl.order_line_id=ol.id AND #{allScope}=FALSE AND (hidden_w.manager_user_id IS NULL OR hidden_w.manager_user_id<>#{actorUserId}) ) hidden_scope_task_count FROM aps_order o JOIN aps_order_line ol ON ol.order_id=o.id JOIN aps_item i ON i.id=ol.item_id JOIN aps_production_lot pl ON pl.order_line_id=ol.id AND pl.status<>'CANCELLED' JOIN aps_task t ON t.production_lot_id=pl.id AND t.status<>'CANCELLED' LEFT JOIN aps_work_center c ON c.id=t.work_center_id LEFT JOIN aps_workshop w ON w.id=c.workshop_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pm.task_id,MAX(pj.planned_end_at) planned_end_at FROM aps_plan_job_member pm JOIN aps_plan_job pj ON pj.id=pm.plan_job_id WHERE #{planVersionId} IS NOT NULL AND pj.plan_version_id=#{planVersionId} GROUP BY pm.task_id ) planned ON planned.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT per_lot.source_task_id task_id,SUM(per_lot.released_qty) released_qty, MAX(per_lot.released_at) released_at FROM ( SELECT out_lot.id,out_lot.source_task_id, CASE WHEN out_lot.quality_status IN ('RELEASED','CLOSED') AND out_lot.disposition_type<>'REWORK' THEN out_lot.total_qty-out_lot.scrapped_qty ELSE 0 END released_qty, MAX(CASE WHEN qe.event_type='QUALITY_RELEASE' THEN qe.occurred_at END) released_at FROM aps_output_lot out_lot LEFT JOIN aps_quantity_event qe ON qe.output_lot_id=out_lot.id GROUP BY out_lot.id,out_lot.source_task_id,out_lot.quality_status, out_lot.disposition_type,out_lot.total_qty,out_lot.scrapped_qty ) per_lot GROUP BY per_lot.source_task_id ) terminal_release ON terminal_release.task_id=t.id WHERE (#{orderId} IS NULL OR o.id=#{orderId}) AND (#{allScope}=TRUE OR w.manager_user_id=#{actorUserId}) ORDER BY o.order_no,ol.line_no,t.task_code
